_source: ތާނައިގައި ހުރި ނުކުތާޖެހި އަކުރުތައް ބޭނުންކުރާނެ ހަމަ (Rules for using dotted/thikijehi letters in Thaana), Dhivehi Bahuge Academy, ISBN 978-99915-69-61-1, 14 April 2024. Extracted from thaanaiga-huri-nukuthaajehi-290524.pdf.
_summary: Default is plain (non-dotted) letters. Thikijehi is minimized: kept only for the cases listed in 'keep' and 'required_thikijehi'. When Radheef lists both forms, the Academy prefers the plain one.

reduce_to_plain._rule: Rule 5 substitution table: foreign Arabic sounds alien to Dhivehi are written with the nearest Dhivehi letter.

_also_reduce_in_general_use._note: Rule 9 (Radheef prefers plain) + examples across the doc. These have thikijehi only in the required categories or as homograph markers; otherwise plain.

keep_dhivehi_sounds._rule: Rule 3: these three are now considered Dhivehi sounds and must NOT be dropped.

required_thikijehi._rule: Rules 1,4,6,10 + homographs: write WITH dots in these cases.

radheef_prefers_plain_examples._rule: Rule 9: Radheef's plain form is preferred when two forms exist.

homographs_keep_dots._rule: Rule 1: where dropping the dots changes the word, the dots stay. Curated from Radheef pairs whose definitions differ (checked by hand 2026-09-26), plus the Academy's own examples.
